name: v0.163.2
body:
This release updates the binaries' Go version and CA bundle. It fixes #1722.

To see the collector changes in v0.163.x see [v0.163.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/tag/v0.163.0)

## Changelog
* 6c65793ec707f673304e52dfcb642684fda1a048 [chore] Prepare release 0.163.2 (#1726)
* fb0342cf6d12ea5b95697eb39564fe48b2f407df maint: ensure we use the latest Go and CA bundles (#1723)
* 94fec53ca1bf43dd47f180067db5675328705fde Update golang:1.27-alpine3.23 Docker digest to 895e5fe (#1720)
* 022f62959e0703f56ebe98df8e3801fafb60c17a Update github-actions deps (#1721)
